subject: health
concept: Preparing for a realistic wellness setback (injury, illness, major life change) with a resilience-based response plan
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Resilience Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student adjusts their own wellness plan from Grade 11 in response to a described setback
exercise.abstract: Student explains how they would adapt their wellness approach to weather a realistic setback

assessment.mastery_threshold: response includes realistic adaptations rather than assuming the setback won't affect their plan at all
misconception_flags: response has no adaptation at all, assuming the original plan proceeds unaffected by a genuine setback

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
